授業概要
人の発達の諸過程を、社会・文化・歴史的なプロセスと切り結んで理解することによって浮き上がってくる問題についてエコロジカルな観点から議論し、地球規模での課題への取り組みを模索する。
This course aim to explore the ways in which we can approach the problems and difficulties we are facing
at grobal scale through the dialogic discussion on the issues shed light on by understanding human development as process involving sociocultural historic practices. Ecological perspectives are bourght into the discussion.
